Product Tour · one full cycle, real screens

From an idea to a governed, running government agent — in 15 steps.

This is the whole cycle a MoHRE officer goes through in Wakeel: describe an agent, review it, test it, run it, automate it, publish it, and watch it — all chat-first, in Arabic or English — then scaled with multi-agent teams, workspace governance, enterprise security and in-country AI. Every screen below is the live product.

1
Build

The officer signs in

Any MoHRE employee signs in with their entity account — no developer, no setup. Wakeel opens in Arabic or English.

wakeel · sign in
2
Build

Describe the agent — and review before building

Type the job in plain language. Wakeel reasons through triggers, integrations, data fields, statuses and guardrails, then shows a full design proposal — the flow, the node table, the registry schema — and asks “Shall I build this agent?” You can refine it in chat, then press Build. Nothing is created until you approve.

wakeel · design proposal
Editable by chatting — e.g. “add an Arabic translation step” or “require officer sign-off before any rejection.”
3
Build

Review the flow — chat-first

The agent opens as the real orchestration diagram with the Build Assistant beside it. Every change is by chat — add a step, add a condition, change the tone — no diagrams to draw. Run and Publish are one click away.

wakeel · agent · flow
4
Build

Governance & guardrails — auto-generated

Because it’s a government agent, Wakeel writes a policy layer for it: a decision boundary, guardrails, the human-in-the-loop checkpoints, allowed statuses and the escalation policy. This is what keeps it advisory — it recommends, people decide.

wakeel · agent · governance
5
Build

Automation modes — Copilot or Autopilot

Choose how much the agent does on its own — for the whole agent and per step. Copilot pauses for an officer’s approval in the Inbox; Autopilot runs end-to-end. Human-in-the-loop exactly where it matters.

wakeel · agent · automation
6
Operate

Test it — with a scored dataset

Build a test dataset, run it, and Wakeel scores each output with an LLM judge — pass/fail with reasons and an overall evaluation score. When cases fail, one click optimises the prompts to fix them.

wakeel · agent · evaluate
7
Operate

Run it — one button, live

Trigger the agent on demand: type an input and watch each step run live, then read the result — exactly what happens when a schedule or event fires. Or set it to run automatically on a timer, a webhook, or a Microsoft 365 event.

wakeel · run & triggers
8
Operate

The live data — as a native table

The registry the agent reads and writes is a native, searchable table — colour-coded compliance statuses, add or edit records — no spreadsheet hunting.

wakeel · agent · records
9
Operate

Automate across your systems — by chat

Describe an automation and Wakeel builds it in your connectors (Microsoft 365, Google, HTTP…): schedule → read Excel → ask the agent → send / update / escalate → summary. It calls your agents for the AI, and runs on your infrastructure — no diagrams to draw.

wakeel · automations
10
Scale

Publish & connect — an API for any system

Publish makes the current version live for triggers and automations. A Beam-compatible REST API lets any government system call your agents — issue a key and copy a curl command.

wakeel · developers & API
11
Scale

Monitor & decide

Analytics tracks completion, approval and feedback scores over time with runtime and per-agent breakdowns. The Inbox is where officers approve, reject or edit every draft before it’s actioned — agents draft, people decide.

analytics
inbox
12
Enterprise

Many agents, one request — Agent Teams

A Team is a supervisor that reads an incoming request, routes it to the right specialist agents, runs them, and combines their work into one answer — true multi-agent collaboration. One citizen request can be summarised, routed and reviewed by three different agents at once, with the supervisor’s plan shown end to end.

wakeel · teams
The supervisor plans, runs each specialist, then synthesises — you see every step.
13
Enterprise

The accountable record — Governance & Audit

Every action across the workspace — who did what, when — is captured in one audit trail, filterable by category and exportable to CSV for auditors. Above it sits the live compliance posture: data residency, the standards in force (ISO/IEC 27001, UAE PDPL, ADDA policies…), the model & data policy, and the human-in-the-loop approval record.

wakeel · governance
Real audit events, canonical compliance tags and one-click CSV export.
14
Enterprise

Enterprise identity — RBAC, SSO & in-country AI

Role-based access (Administrator / Officer / Viewer) governs who can do what. Single sign-on connects to Microsoft Entra ID, SAML 2.0 or UAE PASS, alongside a session policy — timeout, MFA, allowed domains, IP allowlist. And when Azure OpenAI (UAE North) is configured, every inference stays in-country: no prompt or output leaves the UAE.

wakeel · security
In-country AI residency, RBAC roles and Entra ID SSO — the go-live identity controls.
15
Scale

Everyday helpers — Skills in chat

Beyond agents, ready-made Skills run right in chat — draft a bilingual letter, classify a complaint, translate Arabic⇄English, summarise a document, pre-check an application. Pick one, paste your text, get the result.
